outline.description: Lists the definitions a file declares, each with its line range and the line IDs that edit it. The first look at an unfamiliar file.
outline.tip: Tip: Pass sexp to get the whole parse tree instead, which is what a custom 'inspect' query is written against.

inspect.description: Inspects code structure and finds target lines in source files using Tree-sitter.
inspect.tip: Tip: Use templates like 'functions' or 'classes' for quick navigation.

view.description: Retrieve file lines along with persistent Line IDs. Set only_ids to true to retrieve only IDs and line numbers, excluding text contents.
view.tip: Tip: Specify start_line and end_line range to view only relevant chunks.

edit.description: Apply edits transactionally to a file. Returns only status and the list of modified Line IDs in a compact flat array.
edit.tip: Tip: Always verify Line IDs before applying edits to prevent conflict.

create.description: Create a new file and initialize its editing session. Returns only metadata and the generated Line IDs in a compact flat array (no file content).
